title: Luminescentkelp
body:
Description

Luminescent Kelp (stylized as Luminescent Kelp in-game) is a tree which can be found exclusively in the underground lake past the Finlay entrance to Mike's Mines. It is a teal-colored variety of kelp with unique glowing leaves.

Trivia

  • Unusually, the glowing effect present on the leaves of Luminescent Kelp is not present in its sanded or planked forms, a trait that no other trees with glowing parts possess.
